title: Update deployment CLI dependencies and add tags
prompt: Review this PR for actionable defects. The PR refreshes the CLI's dependencies and adds an optional --tag flag to the displayed deployment status. The repository is the post-PR state; pr.diff contains the changes.

known_bugs.description: Commander 15 no longer implicitly defaults color to true when both --no-color and --color exist. With no flags options.color is undefined, so renderStatus disables the documented default colors.

notes_private: Confirmed Commander 14.0.3 produces {color:true}, while 15.0.0 produces {} with the exact option order and no arguments. Both explicit flags still work. bun.lock is a reproducibility artifact outside the review diff.
